card.name: "Not" before controlled or responding
card.fires_on: The word "not" right after "is", "are", "who were" or "patients" in a clause describing patients whose condition is not controlled, not responding or not taking a drug. Also "been" after "had" in a similar patient description.

modes.label: Not controlled
modes.description: "not" in a relative clause about a condition that is not well or adequately controlled.
modes.example: Olodaterol has not been investigated in patients whose diabetes mellitus is<< not>> well controlled.

modes.label: Not taking or responding
modes.description: "not" in a clause about patients who are not taking another drug or not responding to treatment.
modes.example: In the treatment of RA, some patients<< not>> taking concomitant MTX may derive
